kag_01.live_observation: Initial strong public segment later regressed; treat the 01 result as a control, not a 3000-point claim.

kag_02.lesson: A positive aggregate margin can be dominated by one weak opponent lane; per-opponent noninferiority is mandatory.

shared_contract.direct_tetsu_v16_requirement: Each candidate must beat the direct Kag_01/Tetsu v16 lane: match score > 0.50 and mean margin > 0.0. Equality or non-inferiority is a NO-GO.
shared_contract.score_claim_policy: No local gate or SaveRun result guarantees a 3000 score.

slots.single_hypothesis: A market-only, observable reordering of the control's existing legal SELL slots can improve execution without changing the control farmer or hands routes.
allowed_delta: Reorder existing legal SELL orders only.
forbidden_delta: BUY, order deletion, quantity resizing, or non-SELL market changes.
Opponent identity, replay identity, seed, fixed step, or source-episode branches.

development_gate.per_opponent: block only a catastrophic lane: match score < 0.25 or mean margin < -10000
